verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the incorporation form is an online flow entered through Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital, professional certificate or eIDAS authentication. The pacto social is generated automatically from data entered in that form, so nothing shows the forms or pre-approved pact models can be downloaded without an account. The public service page does publish guidance, but readable instructions alone do not deliver the downloadable forms the story requires.

support.subject: As a founder, the forms themselves and their instructions are downloadable from the service's site without an account
